searchText: Is the general expectation that for the production deposit contract `MIN_GENESIS_ACTIVE_VALIDATOR_COUNT` will be met before `MIN_GENESIS_TIME`? This implies that enough validators have deposited in b/t the deposit contract deployment and the beginning of the year right? The timing sounds tight to me but I’m not sure anyone really knows Yeah, I was wondering if perhaps there was a plan/expectation that might influence how those constants are set I was just wondering because it might influence how we handle waiting for genesis (from a client optimization perspective) how would it be different with/without a fixed genesis time ? basically it's cheaper to check if `time < MIN_GENESIS_TIME` than to check `is_valid_genesis_state()` ah yeah, that is true but even then , you would need some way to cache the relevant parts of the state for `is_valid_genesis_state` otherwise you would re-process all the received deposits each time you get a new deposit and `time > MIN_GENESIS_TIME` The ideal scenario (for minimal computation) is that the deposit contract fills up prior to `time == MIN_GENESIS_TIME`. In that case you only need to process the deposits once.
